title: Sitemap Extractor & Indexability Auditor Input
description: Extract Sitemap URLs fast without proxies and audit HTTP status, redirect chains, robots.txt conflicts, noindex tags, canonicals, SEO/JSON-LD, AI search bots, and /llms.txt.

startUrls.title: Start URLs (Domains or Sitemaps)
startUrls.description: Domain root URLs (e.g. https://www.sitemaps.org) or explicit Sitemap URLs (e.g. https://example.com/sitemap.xml). Also accepts Apify RequestList objects ({ "url": "..." }) via API.

mode.title: Audit mode
mode.description: Choose between ultra-fast Sitemap extraction only, 4-point Indexability auditing, or full technical SEO + JSON-LD + AI crawler diagnostics.
enumTitles: Indexability audit (HTTP, redirects, robots, noindex, canonical)
Full audit (+ HTML SEO, JSON-LD, AI search bots, /llms.txt)

maxUrlsPerDomain.title: Max URLs per domain
maxUrlsPerDomain.description: Maximum unique URLs extracted and emitted per domain from discovered Sitemaps.

maxAuditPagesPerDomain.title: Max audit pages per domain
maxAuditPagesPerDomain.description: Maximum URLs to fetch and audit per domain (automatically treated as 0 in extract_only mode).

includeAiBotAudit.title: Include AI search bot & /llms.txt audit
includeAiBotAudit.description: Compare desktop browser reachability against OAI-SearchBot, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, and PerplexityBot on the domain root, and inspect /llms.txt (skipped in extract_only mode).

outputMode.title: Dataset output mode
outputMode.description: Choose whether to write domain summaries, URL rows, or both to the default Dataset. Key-Value Store record SUMMARY is always saved.
enumTitles: URL rows only (SUMMARY still saved to KVS)

maxSitemapFiles.sectionDescription: Control Sitemap recursion limits, HTTP concurrency, issue-only Dataset filtering, and optional proxy escalation.
maxSitemapFiles.title: Max Sitemap files per domain
maxSitemapFiles.description: Maximum number of Sitemap files (including nested sitemapindex children) fetched per domain.

concurrency.title: HTTP concurrency per domain
concurrency.description: Maximum simultaneous HTTP requests per domain.

onlyIssuesInDataset.title: Output only URLs with issues
onlyIssuesInDataset.description: When enabled, only URL records with at least one detected issue are pushed to the Dataset (noise reduction mode).

autoEscalateProxy.title: Auto-escalate to Apify Proxy on block
autoEscalateProxy.description: Start with free direct HTTP requests and automatically escalate to Apify Proxy only if HTTP 403/429/503 or a WAF challenge is detected.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify Proxy settings. Disabled by default for fast, zero-proxy operation.
